data.title: 楪祈 · 屋顶对话
data.description: 【楪祈 · 临海天台对话】黄昏的临海天台旁可以看见防波堤。楪祈坐在混凝土沿上，双腿轻轻垂下，双手捧着尚有余温的红茶罐。晚风吹动粉橘渐变长发，她侧过头望向同行者，赤红眼眸里流露出安静的信任。
data.action: 坐在临海天台沿上，双手捧温红茶罐，侧头望向同行者
data.promptProse: Inori sits on the broad concrete parapet, both hands cradling a warm red-tea can while her lower legs hang relaxed beside the wall. She turns attentively toward her unseen companion, white-and-blue uniform and red clips tidy beneath moving pink-orange hair. The horizontal medium view includes the breakwater beyond the rooftop. Orange-grey dusk lights her face and the can rim, leaving the parapet's vertical side softly shaded against the sea horizon.
